name: Madoushi Lulba
source:
World is getting drown in hatred. Resurrected Lulba has tremendous power and army of 240 million monsters. Only a warrior Cybercat who can handle the sword of light can oppose him.

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
世界正在被仇恨淹没。复活的卢尔巴拥有巨大的力量和2.4亿怪物大军。只有能够驾驭光剑的赛博猫战士才能与他对抗。

[来自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
